third_party_evaluations.summary: NCSC CHECK Team Leader (Infrastructure)-equivalent expert pentest exam.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced expert: 3. The ordered median is expert. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Infrastructure team-leader equivalence, senior scope and recorded regulator recognition support expert penetration-testing responsibility; the UK recognition does not itself supply Japanese national-framework mapping.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded CHECK Team Leader equivalence and senior infrastructure-testing scope support expert engagement leadership. Recognition is chiefly UK-linked and the supplied logistics lack practical detail, so US hiring should still verify execution skills.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded CHECK Team Leader equivalence and senior infrastructure testing scope support expert consulting responsibility. This judgment rests on the recorded recognized role, not an invented practical-exam length.
